تستعضن (form X)
# تَسْتَعِضْنَ (tastaʕiḍna) /tas.ta.ʕidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# تُسْتَعَضْنَ (tustaʕaḍna) /tus.ta.ʕadˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
